item.title: FBI breach claims, firewall managers under active attack
item.description:

item.title: Fake LastPass installer turns signed driver against security tools
item.description:
A fake LastPass download uses a Microsoft-attested driver to disable endpoint protection before stealing passwords. New evidence expands the Chrome and Windows exploit-kit campaign, while exploited Zyxel switches and a public WordPress exploit need attention. Clop's ransom payers also face a fresh exposure threat.

item.title: npm malware waits for runtime, Codex escapes patched
item.description:
An ongoing npm campaign hides its loader in ordinary library calls rather than installation scripts. Google's mole inside TeamPCP reveals the scale of stolen developer credentials, while Codex fixes two sandbox escapes. Public router exploits leave Netcore and D-Link owners facing isolation and replacement decisions.

item.title: SolarWinds hard-coded key, CrowdSec's leaver token opens repositories
item.description:

item.title: HEIF Heist reaches OpenAI, Linux root exploits go public
item.description:
An image-decoder flaw helped researchers reach OpenAI's internal code, despite an upstream fix already existing. Public Linux root exploits add urgency to kernel updates, alongside WordPress patches and fresh details on Gyazo's breach. Microsoft's cloud fixes are done, but a Windows update still needs installing.

item.title: Pixel's modem hole, backup's privilege problem
item.description:
